description:
Visual Studio Tools for Office Developer 
 

 On behalf of our client, Procom Services is searching for a Visual Studio Tools for Office Developer for a long term contract opportunity in Hillsboro, OR.
 
 
 Visual Studio Tools for Office Developer Job Details 
 

 Developing and maintaining applications central to supply/demand forecasting processes within a geographically distributed team with a co-located QA team. 
 

 You will primarily be responsible for VSTO development/support for Excel 2013 add-ins. That will include reviewing current state design, working with the technical lead to define future state design, develop, document, test and publish your solution. Prototyping/research solutions. 
 

 Visual Studio Tools for Office Developer Mandatory Skills 
 Experience with VSTO, C#, .NET 4.5+, TDD, VS2015/TFS & Design Patterns. 
 
 
 Visual Studio Tools for Office Developer Nice to Have Skills  
 Experience with WPF, Microsoft BI, EF6+ and supporting multiple applications in a production environment.
 

 Visual Studio Tools for Office Developer Start Date 
 

 ASAP
 
 
 Visual Studio Tools for Office Developer Assignment Length 
 

 18 months


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Please send your resume in Word format only.
